cohort: 404 pregnant women from the Biochemical and Epigenetic Origin of Overweight and Obesity (OBESO) cohort were included.
finding: First trimester vitamin D deficiency was associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes mellitus (aOR 2.04, 95% CI 1.14-3.65, p = 0.01).
mod_finding: No association was found between first trimester vitamin D deficiency and cesarean section.
